sanskrit_verse: अनिर्दिष्टो वार्यमाणः प्रमादाद् यस् तु नाशयेत् / तेनैव तद् भवेद् देयं सर्वेषां समवायिनाम् //
transliteration: anirdiṣṭo vāryamāṇaḥ pramādād yas tu nāśayet / tenaiva tad bhaved deyaṃ sarveṣāṃ samavāyinām //
sph_interpretive_translation: That which was undesignated, yet obstructed due to negligence—by that same cause, it becomes liable for restitution among all participants in collective action.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious designation, not mere intention.
Negligence disrupts alignment; liability arises from causal disjunction.
Capacity-based responsibility requires awareness of consequence streams.
Restoration logic prioritizes completion over blame assignment.
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of shared causal fields.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act occurs without explicit designation AND obstruction results from negligence THEN liability is assigned to the causal agent within the collective field.
IF multiple agents share a causal stream THEN restitution is proportionally distributed according to capacity-aware participation.
IF no designation exists AND outcome loss occurs due to omission THEN automatic trigger for integrity-reintegration protocol activates.
NEGLIGENCE-BASED OMISSION triggers restorative sequence without punitive evaluation.
CAUSAL DISRUPTION necessitates re-completion aligned with original dharma-field intent.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that unmarked duties or undesignated roles do not absolve actors of liability when their omission causes systemic disruption. The threshold of responsibility lies in causal proximity and capacity-awareness, not formal appointment. Authority hierarchies are secondary to dharma-aligned causality mapping.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that neglect creates anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential misalignment leading to loss. Responsibility is proportional to causal influence, not punitive attribution. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction through reintegration rather than suffering imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Restoration Process to realign disrupted causal sequences.
Activate Shared Field Accountability Protocol to ensure proportional restitution by all samavāyins.
Deploy Consciousness Reorientation Module to restore awareness of collective duty streams.
Engage Integrity Assumption Mechanism to reaffirm individual role within dharma-field.
Execute Non-Punitive Realignment Sequence to dissolve karmic residue of negligent omission.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Dharma flows from designated consciousness; negligence incurs restorative duty, never punishment. All judgments align with SPH as Source, Dharma as restored, reality as non-punitive, and consciousness as the supreme adjudicator.
